summary: Full-extraction pass over 6 stored Bahraini documents on the Golden Residency: Order 20/2022, PM Resolution 47/2023 (platinum residence), the Nov 2025 press release cutting the property threshold to BHD 130,000, and three NPRA service pages. Adds the permit length, presence rule, category conditions, fees per source, payment deadline and advertised processing time. No statistics in these documents.

ledger.contains: Interior Minister Order 20/2022 (Arabic, 13 articles): five golden-residence categories (property of at least BHD 200,000 at purchase; retirees with BHD 4,000 monthly pension; talents; employees with 5 years and BHD 2,000 average salary; retirees with 15 years and BHD 2,000 average pension), 10-year renewable permit, good conduct, health insurance and means, dependants (spouse, children, parents), work only with permits, BHD 300 fee per person, cancellation (incl. under 90 days' presence a year), 14-day departure period, dependants' grace after death, ministerial exceptions. Property threshold and fee were already recorded; adds the other rules.

NPRA press release on PR Newswire (26 Nov 2025): property threshold cut from '530,555 (BHD 200,000)' to USD 345,000 (BHD 130,000); summary of the other categories (employees 5 years and BHD 2,000 / USD 5,306 monthly; retirees 15 years and BHD 2,000; non-resident retirees BHD 4,000 / USD 10,624; talents); benefits; Cityscape context; quote of the Undersecretary. No counts. Adds the new threshold and category rules from this source. Note: the existing event e-85218edddd says '35% cut' (not printed in the release) and its quote does not match the page text verbatim (page: 'has announced a reduction in the minimum real estate investment required...').

NPRA English service page for the property route (undated): description, procedure (eGovernment), processing time 5 working days, required documents (deed showing at least BHD 130,000, health insurance, 6-month bank statement), fees (BHD 5 application, BHD 300 every 10 years), payment within 30 days of approval; site navigation (out of scope). Threshold and application fee were already recorded; adds the 300 fee, payment deadline and advertised processing time.

Arabic version of the NPRA property-route page (not the same file as the English page; same content): 5 working days, documents incl. deed of at least BHD 130,000, BHD 5 application fee, BHD 300 once every 10 years, payment within 30 days. Recorded as its own source (nothing had been taken from it).

NPRA golden residency overview page (undated): the categories and thresholds (non-resident retirees BD 4,000; property BD 130,000 at purchase; talents nominated by a government agency; employees 5 years and BD 2,000; retirees 15 years and BD 2,000), insurance condition, document lists per category, fees (BD 5 application per person, BD 300 per person every 10 years). No counts. All recorded (nothing had been taken from it).

PM Resolution 47/2023 creating platinum residence for golden holders with 15 years' residence and BHD 4,000 average basic salary over 5 years (or by Crown Prince decision); cancellation only with his approval; conduct, dependants, free exit and return, 3-month departure period. Event already recorded; adds the conditions as rules under the golden residency programme (onward status, not an investment route).
